messages:
jamal: opened PR #424 to refresh the Quickstart - target: hello-minima single-file apps, clearer auth instructions, add tiny Docker run note, and a short Go example. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/424
leah: love the scope. can we also add a one-line Windows cmd example for setting the env var? beginners get tripped up.
rudy: also please use REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere and show the Authorization: Bearer header in the raw curl sample. i'll scan for older headers.
jamal: noted. i'll replace API_KEY occurrences and add the Windows cmd example (setx vs $env).
docs-bot: preview build queued for PR #424
preview-bot: preview started  will post URL when ready
leah: tiny UX nit: move the Docker snippet above the troubleshooting section so it appears with deploy steps. also add a one-line CORS hint for localhost development.
jamal: done - moved Docker and added a short CORS note. added Windows PowerShell and cmd examples: "setx REDWOOD_API_KEY \"your_key\"" and "$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY=\"your_key\""
rudy: found one lingering reference to old-snippets/hello-old.md in examples index. looks like a broken cross-ref.
jamal: thanks, fixing link now and repushing.
docs-bot: preview ready  https://deploy-preview-424.docs.redwood.ai/preview (diff: hello-minima consolidation, auth var note, Docker placement, Go & Python snippets)
leah: preview looks good. tiny copy tweak: change "set your API key" to "export REDWOOD_API_KEY in your shell" for clarity.
rudy: LGTM after that. please squash doc commits before merging.
jamal: will squash and merge when CI green. filing follow-up ticket to expand troubleshooting appendix (ISSUE #112). merging once checks pass.
